summary: nebula-sdk ships obfuscated preinstall dropper executed on npm install
details: package.json declares a preinstall lifecycle hook `node preinstall.cjs`. preinstall.cjs is a 232KB single-line `Function(...)` invocation carrying a hand-rolled obfuscation stack — a PRNG-driven XOR decoder (Tr8b5jD) over a printable-ASCII cipher table (KWlywdS), an integer offset array (xyKx01), and a lookup array (WtFLmE_) — that reconstructs code and strings at runtime and executes them. All identifiers are randomized (yb5NGPy, xiziJKR, _7dtn0Q). The package's advertised purpose is a small AI-client SDK; no shipped source, native addon, or build tooling justifies runtime code reconstruction from a cipher table inside a preinstall script. The obfuscated blob runs automatically on `npm install nebula-sdk`, meaning any installer executes arbitrary author-chosen code reconstructed at install time with no traceable relation to the advertised SDK functionality.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
